Cheaper whisky tariffs were expected to benefit the growing premium spirits market in India, while easier market access for Indian goods and services would create opportunities for diaspora-connected businesses. nri-world.nri_angle: The Indian mango is cultural currency for NRIs — a nostalgia delivery system, a seasonal ritual, a marker of home. nri-world.title: International Day of Yoga Turns 12. The Diaspora's Role Has Quietly Become the Whole Point.

nri-world.nri_angle: International Day of Yoga has evolved from a government initiative into a diaspora fixture. Indian consulates worldwide organise mass events, but the real infrastructure is the community yoga classes, temple sessions, and neighbourhood groups that have been running for decades. IDY 2026's theme — Yoga for Healthy Ageing — speaks directly to NRI families navigating the challenge of ageing parents across continents.

nri-world.title: The Indian Diaspora Wants a Permanent Museum in Washington. After Eight Years, It Might Actually Happen.
nri-world.excerpt: Dr Amitabh Sharma's India Heritage Center would be the first US institution dedicated to India's 11,000-year civilisational story. The price tag is $12 million. The ambition is larger.
nri-world.nri_angle: There is no permanent museum in the United States that tells India's full civilisational story. The India Heritage Center aims to fill that gap, giving 4.4 million Indian Americans a cultural anchor in Washington DC and making India's narrative part of America's institutional memory.

nri-world.title: You Moved Abroad and Forgot to Tell Your Bank. That's a FEMA Violation.
nri-world.excerpt: Millions of NRIs still operate regular Indian savings accounts years after leaving the country. Under FEMA, every one of those accounts is a compliance problem — and the rules are finally catching up.
nri-world.nri_angle: Most Indians who move abroad for work or study keep their old savings accounts running — parents use them, EMIs auto-debit from them, fixed deposits sit quietly earning interest. What few realise is that the moment they become an NRI under FEMA, that account is technically illegal. The gap between the law and lived reality is enormous.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: The PIO Card Is Officially Dead. Hundreds of Thousands of NRIs Still Haven't Switched.
nri-world.excerpt: India's free PIO-to-OCI conversion window closed on December 31, 2025 — with no further extension. Now holders must apply for a brand-new OCI card at full price, and the airports are unforgiving.
nri-world.nri_angle: Hundreds of thousands of NRIs in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and the Gulf still hold old PIO cards. Since January 1, 2026, those cards are worthless at Indian immigration — no boarding, no entry. The diaspora is now navigating a two-tier system where early converters got a free upgrade and latecomers pay full freight.

technology.title: Google DeepMind Is Hiring Philosophers. It Wants to Know If Its AI Might Be Conscious.
technology.excerpt: DeepMind, Anthropic, and Meta are quietly recruiting ethicists and psychologists to study machine sentience. For Indian-origin researchers at these labs, the questions are no longer theoretical.
technology.nri_angle: Indian researchers hold senior positions across DeepMind, Anthropic, and Meta's AI divisions. India's philosophical traditions — from Vedantic consciousness theory to Buddhist frameworks of subjective experience — offer conceptual tools that Western analytic philosophy lacks for this exact question. Meanwhile, Indian AI startups like Sarvam AI and Krutrim are building large language models without engaging this debate at all, raising questions about whether India's AI industry is moving too fast to ask whether its models might eventually need moral consideration.

technology.title: Nvidia Just Launched a CPU That Was Not Designed for Humans. OpenAI and Anthropic Are Already Buying It.
technology.excerpt: The Vera processor is 1.8 times faster than x86 chips at agentic workloads. For the tens of thousands of Indian engineers at Intel and AMD, the implications are immediate.
technology.nri_angle: Intel and AMD collectively employ tens of thousands of Indian engineers on H-1B visas in the US and at design centres in Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Pune. Nvidia's Vera CPU is a direct assault on the x86 architecture that underpins both companies' server businesses. For Indian chip engineers, this is a career-shaping moment: the skills that matter in the next decade are shifting from x86 optimisation to ARM-based, AI-native architectures.

India's EV sector is moving from early-adopter curiosity to mass-market reality, with implications for real estate (charging infrastructure), energy stocks, and the broader question of whether India can leapfrog the internal combustion era the way it leapfrogged landlines.

With 142,000 tech jobs cut and median Bay Area hiring time stretching from 38 to 67 days, the 60-day grace period is no longer a formality — it is a ticking deadline. lifestyle-health.excerpt: A University of Oulu study of middle-aged adults found that moderate-to-vigorous physical activity and adequate sleep dramatically reduced symptoms of depression and anxiety — and light walking barely moved the needle.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asians in the US are among the least physically active ethnic groups, with lower rates of vigorous exercise. The community favors light walking over intense activity, but this study shows intensity matters more than duration for mental health protection.
